text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's legs grew stronger, and her 
fame skyrocketed. At last, her true racing 
career was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said she wants to commit every evil 
imaginable on the track and still be 
feared a hundred years from now. In other 
words, to go down in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing this sparked a new ambition 
within her: to be remembered a century 
from now as the undisputed top Umamusume 
in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, we need to stack up more wins. Her 
next goal was decided: the graded Unicorn 
Stakes, which shares similar conditions to 
her debut race.
